integrity: Complete analytic proof and a standalone supplementary numerical checker; the checker samples parameters and is not an infinite certification. The result is a scientific claim subject to independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Proved for two real-frequency plane waves and origin-symmetric convex bodies in dimensions at least two; not for three tones or nonsymmetric domains. The sharp universal factor is a supremum approached at frequency collision and is not attained by any nonzero fixed-gap signal. The small-gap remainder is local in the shape and direction. The one-dimensional fixed-gap interval formula is previously known.
title: Sharp two-tone Fourier energy growth on symmetric convex bodies
